name: Koyuba Kaori
source:
Game original character.

An idol whose name is known by many all over the country. She lived on Hitogashima as a child, but moved to Tokyo due to her parents’ work. An extreme introvert by nature, she admires a certain woman and auditions to become an idol in order to change herself. She has a strong emotional attachment to Hitogashima and never misses paying her annual hometown tax.
